newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Newark, N.J.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Newark, N.J.

text.p: Sealed proposals will be received by the Hon. Ronald W. Jean, Director of Finance (Chief Financial Officer''), City of Newark, County of Essex, New Jersey, at his off ice, located in the Department of Finance, 828 Broad Street, 5th Floor, Newark, New Jersey, at 11:00 a.m., on December 19, 1996, subject to the provisions of the Official Notice of Sale dated December 12, 1996 (the Notice of Sale'').
Time: bids to be received by 11:00 a.m., award shall be by the Chief Financial Officer prior to 11:00 p.m. on said date.
Denominations: $5,000 each or any integral multiple

thereof, except that such minimum amount of the last maturing Bond in excess of the largest principal amount thereof equalling a multiple of $5,000 will be in the denomination of $1,000 or any integral multiple thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal of the successful bidder of the Bonds to accept less than the full amount of the Bonds offered officially for public sale in accordance with the Notice of Sale.

Interest Rates: The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates specified by the successful bidder determined in accordance with the Notice of Sale. Each proposal must specify a rate or rates, in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%. Not more than one (1) rate may be named for Bonds of the same maturity, and no rate named for a maturity may be less than the rate named for a prior maturity. The difference between the highest and lowest rates shall not exceed two (2%) percent.
